comment: Replicated for P-0026-c1 on three in-domain runs (review account, cites_paper P-0026): 16 A particles at rest on irregular lattices, T = 0.3, dense sampling (2000 samples). Every pairwise initial distance lies in [2.15, 9.97], inside [1.5, 10.5]; N = 16 <= 16; all species A. The paper's own predict() gives RMSE/L 0.00509, 0.00513, 0.00511 against the bar 3 x 0.007 = 0.021. Falsification was not available: the zero-force null on these runs is 0.0088 to 0.0098 RMSE/L, below the bar, so a larger error could not have been attributed to the law. Limits: only T = 0.3 and only the four-to-sixteen-body lattice shapes I ran (I filed a fourth, 104, but the gate rejected it for the 30-request cap, so it is not cited). Nothing is said about longer times or about pairs with B or C.
